headline: Callahan's Passage and Weathered Expanse Flare as Coastal Fronts Subside
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the frantic clashes along Fisherman's Row have abruptly quieted, while fighting has escalated dramatically across the central and northern fronts. Callahan's Passage and the Weathered Expanse saw severe casualty accelerations, logging over seven thousand combined losses in two hours as positions at The Crumbling Passage, Crow's Nest, and Frostmarch continued rapid exchanges. In Mooring County, Colonial forces secured a foothold among eleven Warden redoubts following three fresh base transitions around The Wind Hills. Action in the Linn of Mercy delivered Rotdust into Colonial hands, consolidating the region into full Colonial control as local firing tapered off. Fighting on the Stlican Shelf remains contested with three base turnovers registered amidst cooling overall rates, while Palantine Berm noted brief skirmishing before falling still. Backline territories and eastern waters reported steady garrison routines without operational movements.
